introduction.p: Identify a variable you might use to represent each quantity. Then identify what units would be most appropriate.

statement.p: Remi is studying college student demographics, including their ages. Let be the age of a student, measured in .

solution.p: The unknown quantity is age, which we generally measure in years. So we could say Let a be the age of a student, measured in years.

statement.p: Luka needs to drive from Portland, OR to Boise, ID. Let be the amount of time passed since Luka left Portland, measured in .

solution.p: The amount of time passed is the unknown quantity. Since this is a drive from Portland to Boise, it makes sense to measure this in hours, not minutes or weeks. So we could say Let t be the amount of time passed since Luka left Portland, measured in hours.
